scene_description: A small stone brick ruins structure sits on a flat grass field about 10 blocks from spawn. The structure is a roofless rectangular room (7x7 footprint) with walls 3 blocks high, built from regular stone bricks. Six chiseled stone bricks are embedded in the walls at eye level — four in the back wall and one on each side wall. A doorway on the front (south) wall allows entry. Nearby distractors include oak logs, a cobblestone pile, and coarse dirt to add visual variety. The player must navigate to the structure and identify the chiseled stone bricks among the regular stone bricks.
